arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for telling us. A gas smell needs treating as an emergency, so please do this now: do not use the oven, any switches, or flames. Open doors and windows, and leave the flat with everyone in it. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (or 999 if anyone feels unwell) from outside. Please also tell us: is any CO alarm sounding, and does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? And please reply to confirm everyone is out. We are sending a Gas Safe engineer to make it safe, with a target of today (within 24 hours), and will update you as soon as we have a time. If you can, please also tell us if anyone in the flat is elderly, very young, pregnant or unwell, so they get out first.

arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for telling us. A gas smell needs treating as an emergency, so please do this now: do not use the oven, any switches, or flames. Open doors and windows, and leave the flat with everyone in it. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (or 999 if anyone feels unwell) from outside. Please also tell us: is any CO alarm sounding, and does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? And please reply to confirm everyone is out. We are sending a Gas Safe engineer to make it safe, with a target of today (within 24 hours), and will update you as soon as we have a time. If you can, please also tell us if anyone in the flat is elderly, very young, pregnant or unwell, so they get out first.
